title: Advertisement (for faculty & Administrative post) 03.05.2025 (1)

source.name: Baddi University of Emerging Sciences & Technology, Himachal Pradesh

text:
KEY LINES:
Qualification, Experience and Salary as per UGC Guidelines.
Send your resume to hr@baddiuniv.ac.in by 15.06.2025.

FULL TEXT:
(Estd. Under Act.21 of 2009 of Govt of H.P. and approved by UGC Under Section
22 of UGC Act 1956)
Applications are invited for the following positions for UG/PG Courses
Professors, Associate Professors & Assistant Professors in
 Engineering, Pharmacy, Management, Agriculture & Sciences & Physiotheraphy
 B.S.c. Nursing : (Tutor, Clinical Instructor, Asstt. Prof., Associate Prof. & Professor)
 Librarian, Deputy Librarian & Assistant Librarian :
 Deans (Agriculture, Physiotherapy, Basic Science, Academics, R&D, SW).
 Registrar, Chief Finance & Accounts Officer, Director Training & Placement.
Qualification, Experience and Salary as per UGC Guidelines.
 Veterinarian for Animal House (Pharmacy)
 Lab. Technicians in Pharmacy, Physics & Chemistry : (Diploma with 2 years experience in
relevant field).
 Farm Manager (Agronomy/other agriculture discipline) : M.Sc. in Agronomy/Plant
Breeding/ Soil Science/Horticulture.
 Wardens (Male & Female) : Graduate with 2-3 years experience in relevant field.
 Accountant : Graduate (B.Com.) with 2-3 years experience in relevant field and computer
knowledge must.
 Clerks / P.A. /Senior Assistant : Graduation with 3-5 years experience in relevant field
and computer knowledge must.
 Gardeners : Matriculation with 2 years experience.
 PRO
 Doctor / Nursing Officer.
 Marketing Executives
Send your resume to hr@baddiuniv.ac.in by 15.06.2025.
